Report title: HIV in Prisons, 2020 – Statistical Tables NCJ 302601
Data source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, National Prisoner Statistics, 2016 and 2020
Author: Laura M. Maruschak, BJS Statistician
Table 4. Number of jurisdictions that tested prisoners for HIV while in custody, by HIV testing practices, 2016 and 2020
a/Jurisdictions could specify more than one testing practice.

b/Jurisdictions refer to the 50 state prison systems and the Federal Bureau of Prisons. In 2016, 49 jurisdictions reported data on HIV testing practices for prisoners while in custody; 48 jurisdictions reported data in 2020. See appendix tables 8 and 9 for jurisdiction-level data.
c/See appendix tables 8 and 9 for details on other testing practices.
